items.description: North Sea coast from Staithes to Whitby including tidal River Esk
items.message:
High tides this evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 19:15 to 21:15 on 12/11/2026. 
Locations most affected will be The North Sea coast from Staithes to Whitby including Sandsend and tidal River Esk 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.   
This message will be updated by 2:00AM on Friday 13 November or as the situation changes.

items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding.
Weather conditions are expected to improve and no further flooding is expected.  
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.  
Continue to take care on waterside roads and footpaths and don't put yourself in unnecessary danger.

High tides and forecast weather conditions throughout the evening may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible from 5:45pm to 9:45pm on Thursday 12 November. 
Locations most affected will be low-lying land and roads near rivers or on the coast, with spray being seen on the seafront paths. Flood gates in the area will be closed by the Local Authority which will make access difficult. Please take notice of the Flood Sign at top of South Beach Road. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at King's Lynn of 3.86mAODN at 7:45pm on 12 November, which is 0.6m above tide tables, Wind Force 6, Northerly. No further high tides are expected over the coming days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 9:30AM on Friday 13 November or as the situation changes.
